full_page.content:
Page 21
Jan. Marg. Hoelscher - sale of property --- thanks for success before
Francis M. Walsh - 50 - operation three years ago. lost 64 inches of spine & rectum, ... lived till now but in fearful pain .... Margaret Mc Namary
25 Thomas Bogucki - 46 - not able to walk - only one working of five - wife and three - seemingly better since prayed for last week
Jan. 26th Mrs. Mary Doyle - 55 - 2nd Stroke just recently, has two daughters nuns and two younger daughters at home, a son about to be married
Mrs. Sprague - in Clynic Hospital says she's not Cath. but believes in pray as through frien to prayed for - sent her word we'd pray this time for her physical conversion and then spiritual and that she should please do the same for us.
Page 22 Mrs. (Jos.) Mary E. Schafer - 28 - mastoid operation proposed by Drs. yesterday her fourth baby was born. She is her parents only living child. Drs. were figuring on operation To-morrow .....
Charles Ernest - 50 - non C. police - serious heart ... Det. - Mich. Exposition in Conventional Hall - J. Eliz. Norris - 18 - keeping company Mrs. Angelina Richer - fears T.B. mother of three small - Wm. Neuhauser - now in Fords ...
1938 February
Bridget Hebron - About 58 - takes peculiar spells - shouts with pain at times ....
Ronald Gillis - 26 - nearly lost arm last Oct .... Now threatined with 2nd operation - Enrolled To-night ... perpetually.
Page 23 Feb. 2nd Edward Humpert - 39 - has wife & 3 to support - has had 3 operations for rupture asks prayers .....
